scope: Finite discrete conditioning identities, exact arithmetic checks, bounded file-based retrieval; no model/GPU performance claims

verifier.source: host-dispatched independent subagent review; direct read/execution evidence, not authenticated Engine receipt
verifier.method: Independent code/import/proof review; complete raw-record hashes/replay; separate CPU rerun; alternate exact overlap-TV and Decimal80 KL/normalizer; primary-source screening

limitations: Independent finite proof review, no Lean/formal proof or universal bug-free certification
All cases are public development checks; no model quality improvement, held-out model tests, model A/B, GPU/production performance claim
Binary64 absolute tolerance and Decimal80 sample reference are not certified floating-point enclosures; extreme underflow is accepted only in absolute error
Direct host independent review; no authenticated Engine runtime deployment/receipt
Knowledge card remains candidate at review; canonical show/hash verified, published retrieval/context/cost and check-refs acceptance require later independent integration validation
Elapsed is one CPU arithmetic repeat metadata; retrieval cost protocol labels ceil(UTF8 bytes/4) as estimate only; no model tokens measured

implementation.reason: Read all standalone code/imports (Python standard library); execution reads frozen case_config. Independent overlap-TV/Decimal80 formulas agree. Helpers are bounded harness code, not generic production APIs.

data_integrity.reason: All active v2 manifest artifact and plan SHA256 bindings checked before/after; gzip is complete lossless JSON, identical to uncompressed producer and independent rerun. Exactly1731 records with summary counts, maximum and finite metric units reconciled.

numerical_sanity.reason: Zero exact rational violations; maximum recorded finite binary64 error2.220446049250313e-16 <=1e-12; independent Decimal80 reference max float error5.551115123125783e-17. No unexplained NaN/Inf; positive-over-zero KL is intentional infinity; extreme sigmoid underflow judged by absolute error.

measurement_validity.reason: perf_counter covers CPU arithmetic loop only; single-repeat seconds metadata, no speed comparison. Cases development only. Retrieval protocol labels UTF8-byte/4 ceiling as estimate, not model tokens; published retrieval measurement is not claimed accepted here.

reproducibility.reason: Fresh standalone rerun to distinct output/raw paths reproduces every case record and deterministic summary excluding elapsed/path; actual Python/platform match environment. Candidate corpus validates, canonical pinned show resolves matching proof text; original sources/versions/locators independently read and adopt/defer decisions recorded.
